historical_scope: Spartan.Spec retains the padded tuple and scalar-oracle proof contexts. Spartan.Protocol and Spartan.Security own the seven-stage protocol on original R1CS instances.
shared_layout: Spartan.PublicParams and toSizeR1CS are the canonical layout definitions.

delegation.Spartan.Spec.oracleReduction.firstMessag: SendSingleWitness.oracleReduction for an already padded instance
delegation.Spartan.Spec.zeroCheckVirtualPolynomial: Spartan.Algebra.residualMLE, with zeroCheckVirtualPolynomial_eq_sum for historical integer-row proofs
delegation.Spartan.Spec.secondSumCheckVirtualPolyno: Spartan.Algebra.secondVirtual, with secondSumCheckVirtualPolynomial_eq_terms for historical distributed-term proofs

prior_second_polynomial_construction.source:
def secondSumCheckVirtualPolynomial
    (stmt : Statement.AfterLinearCombination R pp)
    (oStmt : ∀ i, OracleStatement.AfterLinearCombination R pp i) :
      MvPolynomial (Fin pp.ℓ_n) R :=
  let r := stmt.1
  let r_x := stmt.2.1
  let x := stmt.2.2.2
  let z := R1CS.𝕫 x (oStmt (.inr (.inr 0)))
  let zMLE : MvPolynomial (Fin pp.ℓ_n) R := MvPolynomial.MLE (z ∘ finFunctionFinEquiv)
  let matrixEval (idx : R1CS.MatrixIdx) : MvPolynomial (Fin pp.ℓ_n) R :=
    (oStmt (.inr (.inl idx))).toMLE
      ⸨(MvPolynomial.C ∘ r_x : Fin pp.ℓ_m → MvPolynomial (Fin pp.ℓ_n) R)⸩
  let scalar (a : R) : MvPolynomial (Fin pp.ℓ_n) R := MvPolynomial.C a
  scalar (r .A) * matrixEval .A * zMLE +
  scalar (r .B) * matrixEval .B * zMLE +
  scalar (r .C) * matrixEval .C * zMLE
